findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_state_rules, search_backpr, list_datasets · Private data: find_template, list_datasets · Public sink: find_registration_software, get_directory_stats.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_state_rules, search_backpr, list_datasets · Private data: find_template, list_datasets · Public sink: find_registration_software, get_directory_stats

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
